patterns.label: Cold open
patterns.detail: The first line does the work: 'Cant confirm, but looks like OpenAI is aiming to fire their big guns', 'Google killed Jules AI agent', 'Already filled up my FSD referral link!', 'Please, Tesla, put a standard NEMA 5-20 in the cabin', 'Here is a huge throwback for you all!' Detail lands after the break.

patterns.label: Soft CTA / participation ask
patterns.detail: The FSD referral launch turned into a reply-bait genre: 'Share yours below so others can find them' (51.6k), 'feel free to drop your FSD referral link in the comments' (16k), plus 'make sure you don't miss it' and Starlink referral links. Low-friction asks with a reward attached beat plain news.

patterns.label: Numbered stack / stat block
patterns.detail: Dated cumulative lists (Unsupervised FSD 0 to 380K to 1M to 3.1M to 4M miles), cost claims ($10M+ compute on Navier-Stokes, $5B Nscale guarantee, $6.36B Binance hack, $3B chip fab), testingcatalog's bullet-list Daily AI Brief and Claude update list.

patterns.label: Named tools and things
patterns.detail: GPT-6.2 'bel', Gemini 4 Carbon, Jules, Antigravity Plugins, Claude self-assessment, Claude 'ultra' tier, Canva Brush, Grok Bot voices, Nvidia's Nscale backstop, FSD referral program, Robotaxi 6am-2am hours, Cybercab, Blindsight, Starship, NEMA 5-20.

patterns.label: Opinion on a quote
patterns.detail: 19 of 48 hits quote someone else and add a reaction: kimmonismus pushing back on Altman's local-AI comment (59.6k) and pricing math (70.5k), the GPT-6.2 rumor (110.9k). A clear stance on a named person beats a neutral summary.

patterns.label: Owned firsthand content
patterns.detail: Own footage and own experience: JoeTegtmeyer's chip fab drone flight (16.9k), RGVaerialphotos' 2020 Starbase throwback (16.7k), DirtyTesLa's own FSD parking misses and a 13-hour FSD day, BLKMDL3's own referral link.

patterns.label: Timing
patterns.detail: Two clusters: Thu 11 AM to 3 PM PT (Altman takes, NEMA outlet, Starship throwback, Patrick Stewart) and Thu 5 PM to 8 PM PT when the FSD referral program dropped (BLKMDL3 51.6k at 7:27 PM, GPT-6.2 rumor at 4:57 PM). Friday morning brought the chip fab and Daily AI Brief.

virals_narrative: Outsider AI meta (last ~48h): builder launches about agents talking to each other keep winning. A 2.7k-follower account's 'Artil Connect' launch is up to 81.6k, and a 30k-follower builder's 'I kept hitting my Grok Bot usage limits, so I built a desk that sends heavy work to Claude Code' got 41.5k. That second one is the closest match to Jose's lane. Learn-AI roadmaps and curated lists still travel ('stop wasting hours figuring out what to learn in AI' 21.8k, 'I tested 100 AI tools' 6k, best accounts from each lab 8.3k), and the 'Proof you're not late to learn AI' template is being copied word for word by several accounts. Fable 5.5 waiting posts (11.9k from an 861-follower account) and an Anthropic research thread (12k from 1.8k followers) show small accounts can ride lab news. Filtered out: watchlist accounts, news outlets and big aggregators (Washington Post, unusual_whales, RoundtableSpace), a brand account (Oxylabs), and one likely boosted post (9.1k views on 4 likes). The search returned only 12 posts that cleared every filter, short of the 20 target.

Proof you're not late to learn AI
pattern_brief: The FSD referral program was the story of the day on the Tesla side. BLKMDL3's 'already filled up my referral link, share yours below' post hit 51.6k, and referral posts made up 7 of the 48 hits. AI volume was led by kimmonismus: a GPT-6.2 rumor (110.9k), a breakdown of confusing plan-rate math (70.5k), and pushback on Sam Altman's local-AI comment (59.6k). testingcatalog's 'Google killed Jules' got 46k, and its Grok Bot voice settings post got 10.8k. What works: a one-line cold open with a named thing, a clear opinion on a quote, and a cheap participation ask with a reward attached. Owned footage still pays (chip fab flight 16.9k, Starbase throwback 16.7k). For Jose: you already posted your FSD referral link, but it reached 90 views. The better move is a reply-bait version with your ex-Tesla angle and a short FSD clip, posted before 3 PM PT. A second option is a build-in-public post on Grok Bot voices with your own bot.
